{{short description|Russian mathematician}}
'''Robert Adol'fovich Minlos''' ({{langx|ru|Роберт Адольфович Минлос}}; 28 February 1931  – 9 January 2018) was a [[USSR|Soviet]] and [[Russia]]n [[mathematician]] who has made important contributions to [[probability theory]] and [[mathematical physics]]. [[Minlos's theorem|His theorem]] on the extension of [[cylindrical measure]]s to [[Radon measure]]s on the [[dual space|continuous dual]] of a [[nuclear space]] is of fundamental importance in the theory of [[generalized random process]]es.

He died on 9 January 2018 at the age of 86.<ref>[http://iitp.ru/ru/news/2292.htm In memoriam. Роберт Адольфович Минлос (28.02.1931 – 09.01.2018)] {{in lang|ru}}</ref>
